name: Linh Phuoc Pagoda
summary: Walk through Linh Phuoc, the pagoda at Trai Mat covered in mosaic, with a dragon and a tower built from recycled glass. Ride the tourist train from the old station to get there, and allow about 45 minutes on site.
getThere: Tourist train or road to Trai Mat
heroCaption: The mosaic facade at Linh Phuoc
body: The pagoda at Trai Mat is covered in mosaic, with a dragon and a tower that uses recycled glass. On site, allow about 45 minutes.
The tourist train from Da Lat Railway Station is the classic way to arrive. A taxi or motorbike by road is the other. Admission is free.

figures.caption: The bell tower at Linh Phuoc
figures.alt: Bell tower of Linh Phuoc Pagoda at Trai Mat

gettingThere: Linh Phuoc is at Trai Mat, east of the centre. The tourist train from Da Lat Railway Station runs toward it. A taxi or motorbike uses the road.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi or motorbike by road to Trai Mat.

admissionNote: Free (Visit Lâm Đồng). Hours and the train fare from Da Lat station are Check on arrival.
